status: COMPLETE. n=3 per arm per state, all six states (36 graded runs). The 2026-08-23 sweep stopped at 16 of 24 on a Bedrock Opus daily throttle; the remaining 9 runs completed 2026-08-24.
git_commit: 9aa025b (sample 3); 628829b (samples 1-2). Neither touches detector.py/parser.py, so code_version_hash is 288c64f1 for all runs.
caveats: REPORT OFF-ARM RECALL AS A RANGE, NEVER A POINT VALUE. CO 0.71-0.86, KY 0.89-0.98. The frozen task3_20260822 figures (CO 0.857, KY 0.909) are ONE DRAW each.

CO-NO-SUB-STRAND IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE EVIDENCE. It went FAIL/FAIL/PASS across the three off-arm runs: in run 3 the off arm did not invent the sub_strand level at all, and its CO level distribution was identical to the on arm's. The 2026-08-23 claim that zero regression cases changed status was true at n=2 and is FALSE at n=3. Only the two KY cases are reproducible. generate_tables.build_ablation_table now takes its case list from this file rather than from the single frozen run.

CO STILL DEGRADES IN RUN 3 despite that case passing (recall 0.857; it drops the golden strand 'Health, Safety and Nutrition', which the on arm never drops). State-level degradation is reproducible in all three runs; its surface form on CO is not.

LEAD ON THE LEVEL-DISTRIBUTION TABLE, NOT THE RATES. KY's on arm reproduces the golden 3/5/10/26 exactly in all three runs while the off arm inflates strand and deflates sub_strand in all three (5->8/7/10, 10->7/9/6) with domain and indicator untouched. That mechanism is invariant across runs and independent of golden size; the rates are not, and CO's golden is 7 elements.
n=3 IS STILL A SMALL SAMPLE. Enough to establish the direction and to catch one case n=2 called stable. No confidence interval is computed and none should be.
CORPUS TIER: _only_subset (8-15pp). Nothing here speaks to full documents; that is Task 6.

THIS IS NOT eval_detector --stability-runs. That path (measure_stability, gotcha 6) compares only its own probe runs and EXCLUDES the graded run. These are plain repeats with the graded run included in every comparison.
AZ's ON-arm n_detected moved 66/76/76 with recall pinned at 1.000 -- the known listing-page duplication against a 5-element spot-check golden, present in the ON arm and orthogonal to this ablation.

commands.per_run:
ELS_DEPTH_MAP_ENABLED=false  # off arm only; unset for the on arm
python -m evaluation.eval_detector --extraction-dir outputs/08-22-26-4 --state {STATE} --no-cache --report-json paper/results/task3_stability_20260823/reports/{arm}_run{N}_{STATE}.json --output-dir paper/results/task3_stability_20260823/review/{arm}_run{N}
commands.note: rc=1 from eval_detector is EXPECTED where a regression case fails (off-arm CO/KY) and is not a run failure. The health check is n_detected != 0 plus depth_map_passed matching the arm; the run-3 driver asserts both after every run and aborts rather than spending into a throttle.
